base_lineage.reason: TRAIN-245 is prepared on the current optimizer-transfer preregistration lineage but cannot execute until terminal TRAIN-244 publishes the selected 10M optimizer authority.

train244_optimizer.blocker: No TRAIN-244 PR, commit, branch, or terminal evidence artifact is published at this cutoff. LR/beta/WD/clipping/model/data and the exact ordered trace must not be guessed from older 10M recipes.

consumed_accumulation_authority.truth_boundary: LOCAL_FREE single-process CPU correctness evidence; it proves accumulation semantics, not the 10M batch optimum or GPU throughput.

freeze_contract.rule: All fields are copied exactly from terminal TRAIN-244 before optimizer step 1. TRAIN-245 may change only gradient_accumulation_steps.

preregistered_batch_grid.effective_loss_tokens_per_update_definit: exact valid causal loss tokens summed across each committed accumulation group; report realized distribution rather than nominal padded tensor positions
preregistered_batch_grid.cpu_throughput_interpretation: CPU-specific only; do not extrapolate to GPU.

execution_contract.seed_pairing: same random initialization and exact train trace across all accumulation candidates within each seed
execution_contract.optimizer_updates_definition: count of committed AdamW updates at the exact common optimized-token boundary

gradient_noise_probe.name: trace_covariance_over_mean_gradient_squared
gradient_noise_probe.definition: trace(cov(g_micro))/||mean(g_micro)||^2 on a fixed state-preserving microbatch probe
gradient_noise_probe.claim_boundary: local gradient-noise proxy only; never call it an exact theoretical critical batch size

selection_order: reject any numerical failure or control/trace mismatch
retain candidates within 0.5% relative held-out BPB of the best paired-seed mean
among retained candidates select lowest mean CPU wall time
if candidates are within 5% CPU wall time, select the smaller effective batch as the less intrusive statistical change
decision_contract.grid_edge_rule: If accumulation=4 is selected and quality has not plateaued, report GRID_EDGE alongside the selected tested batch; do not extrapolate a larger optimum.

result.reason: TRAIN-244 optimizer authority is missing, so the frozen optimizer/model/data/trace identity and numerical batch comparison cannot lawfully execute.
